name: hacklab-editor-bundle
description: Builds static/vendor/editor.js (CodeMirror 6, MIT) once; node_modules is git-ignored, the bundle is committed. Run: npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild src.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=HLEditor --target=safari16,chrome110 --outfile=../../static/vendor/editor.js --banner:js='/* Hack Lab editor bundle: CodeMirror 6 (MIT, https://codemirror.net). Built by vendor/editor; do not edit. */'
